title: Combined Graduate Level (CGL)
about: Recruitment for Group B and Group C posts in central government ministries and departments.

title: Combined Higher Secondary Level (CHSL)
about: Recruitment for posts like Lower Division Clerk, Junior Secretariat Assistant and Data Entry Operator.

title: Non-Technical Popular Categories (NTPC)
about: Recruitment for non-technical posts in Indian Railways such as clerks, station masters and goods guards.

title: Probationary Officer (PO)

title: Civil Services Examination
about: Exam for IAS, IPS, IFS and other All India and Central Services.
